title: Booked Window Changes: Cartwise Grocery Orders Training Note
content:
## Training note — moving a booked window

This training note sets out, in answered questions, the rule for moving the booked delivery or pickup window of a Cartwise Grocery Orders order.

### The rule

1. A booked window may be moved only while the order is placed.
2. The move must be made no later than the reschedule cutoff before the booked window start. The cutoff is counted in elapsed hours, and the last moment to move is the booked window start less the service level's reschedule cutoff hours, inclusive.
3. A service level allows its own maximum number of reschedules per order, counted by the reschedules already used on the order.
4. The new window must lie within the service level's advance-booking days of the date of the move.
5. Rescheduling never changes the fees fixed at checkout.

Status, window start and reschedules used are read from the order record.

### Questions answered

**Can the window be moved once the shopper has started shopping?**
No. Only a placed order can have its window moved (rule 1).

**Where exactly is the cutoff?**
It is a moment, not a day: the booked window start less the service level's cutoff hours, counted in elapsed hours. A move at that exact moment is in time; a move after it is not (rule 2).

**Does moving the window change the delivery fee or any other fee?**
No. The fees fixed at checkout stand unchanged (rule 5).

**How many times can one order be moved?**
As many times as the service level's maximum reschedules allows, counted against the reschedules already used on that order (rule 3).

### Boundary cases (hypothetical figures)

Take a booked window starting at 14:00 and, for this illustration, a cutoff of 2 hours; the last moment to move is 12:00 that day.

| Moment of the move | In time |
|---|---|
| 11:59 | Yes |
| 12:00 exactly | Yes — the last moment is inclusive |
| 12:01 | No |

With a cutoff of 0 hours, the last moment to move is the booked window start itself.
